paper.title_en: Deployment of a Graph-Based Track Seeder for the ATLAS Phase-II Tracking Upgrade
paper.abstract_en: The ATLAS experiment is undergoing significant detector, computing and software upgrades for the High-Luminosity LHC (HL-LHC). The ongoing software modernisation is essential to leverage future processing technologies and ensure maintainability throughout the operation of the experiment, while meeting the tracking performance requirements for physics and reducing the compute needs for event reconstruction. To meet these goals, the ATLAS Collaboration is adopting the ACTS (A Common Tracking Software) toolkit, an experiment-independent software for charged-particle track reconstruction. Using ACTS in the ATLAS reconstruction software at the HL-LHC facilitates the development and integration of new algorithms while promoting thread safety, high performance, and code maintainability. This document describes the development and recent deployment of a Graph-Based Track Seeder (GBTS), its underlying methodology, and its expected tracking performance at the HL-LHC.
